Meridian Sync 4.2 Release Notes

New features
- Meridian Sync now supports delta uploads, which cut transfer time for large files by up to 60 percent.
- The new Quiet Hours setting pauses background syncing between 22:00 and 07:00.
- Shared folders can be pinned to the offline cache from the folder menu.

Fixes
- Fixed a crash when renaming a folder that contains more than 10000 files.
- Resolved the conflict-copy bug that duplicated documents edited on two devices.
- It now works with SMB shares on Windows Server 2022.

Known issues
- Delta uploads are disabled for files over 8 GB.
